description.description: A short video sequence shows a man in a white shirt and black apron, presumably a deli owner, behind a glass counter filled with food. He is animatedly shouting and gesturing with his hand and a white cloth at a law enforcement officer who is standing outside the shop or by the entrance. The officer is wearing a dark uniform with 'ICE' on the cap and 'PICF' on a tactical vest, along with a black face mask. Cured meats hang from the ceiling in the background, and small Italian flags are visible in the food display.

Finito! You're coming here with your mask on and my customers making trouble in my neighborhood. Vap-vap! Get the hell out! Sir, we have authority to... Authority? You got no guts.
